request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
(no catalog products referenced)

Claims to verify:
- 30% off applies to all products in the Northbay Supply catalog for the duration of the promotional week
- Discount is applied automatically at checkout
- Sale ends Sunday at midnight
- Not all items may be available in all sizes during the promotional period

Body: Hey,

Winter trips reward preparation more than any other season. The margin between a good day out and a miserable one is usually a few small decisions made before you leave the trailhead.

This week we put together a short winter guide to help you think through those decisions — layering order, pack weight targets for overnight snow travel, what to prioritize when temps drop below 20°F. No filler, just the stuff that actually matters when conditions get serious.

We'd also normally just let the guide speak for itself, but it's worth mentioning: everything in the Northbay Supply catalog is 30% off through Sunday. If there's something you've been weighing — a shell, a sleep system, a headlamp for the short days — this is a straightforward week to pull the trigger.

Head to the site to read the guide and shop the sale. The discount applies automatically at checkout.

Stay warm out there,
The Northbay Supply Team

---

Note: Sale ends Sunday at midnight. Not all items may be available in all sizes during the promotional period.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
